Org mode entities
=================

* User-defined additions (variable org-entities-user)

   Symbol   Org entity        LaTeX code             HTML code
   -----------------------------------------------------------
   ☃        \snowman          \diamond               &#9731;      
   Ⓐ        \alpha            A                      &A;
